- No personal data in a payload, an example or a fake: identifiers, facts and rates only, and the report body is never copied into the L1 payload (BR9).
- The EV-28 payload fields of section 12.3 are classed Not personal on their `agent_run` rows in Data Classification and Personal Data Inventory v5: run ID (DF-AGT-036), agent_code (DF-AGT-037), agent_version (DF-AGT-038), model_version (DF-AGT-040), case_id (DF-AGT-041), autonomy_mode (DF-AGT-043), trigger_event (DF-AGT-044), status (DF-AGT-046), fallback (DF-AGT-047), confidence (DF-AGT-050), latency_ms (DF-AGT-051) and run_at (DF-AGT-995 is not used; see the `run_at` row of `agent_run`). A same-named column of another table does not change the class of these fields.
